title: Premium Billing Accounts — Account Status, Binder, Closure and Payment-Method Changes
content:
**Statuses.** A Premium Billing Accounts arrangement is always in one of five statuses: pending binder, active, in grace period, lapsed or closed.

| From | To | Brought about by | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| pending binder | active | the system | the binder (first premium) payment is received in full |
| pending binder | closed | the system | every enrollment the account was opened for was cancelled for an unpaid binder |
| active | in grace period | the system | a premium due date passed without full payment of the coverage month due |
| in grace period | active | the system | all past-due premium is paid before the grace period ends |
| in grace period | lapsed | the system | the grace period ended without full payment; the funded coverage terminates for nonpayment |
| lapsed | active | the agent | the account is reinstated within the reinstatement window after full payment of all past-due premium |
| lapsed | closed | the system | the reinstatement window ended without reinstatement |
| active | closed | the account holder | the holder closes the account after all funded coverage has ended and the balance is settled |

The account's balance is the premium owed by the account holder, in USD; it is negative when the account holds a credit.

**Opening and binder.** An account is opened in pending binder for a new individual application or group contract, with an arrangement whose entry condition admits the customer type and market, and becomes active when the binder (the premium for the first billing period) is received in full by a method in the arrangement's binder payment methods. It closes without ever becoming active when every enrollment it was opened for has been cancelled for an unpaid binder.

**Holder decisions.** Closing an account and changing how it pays are the account holder's own decisions, registered as a billing request and carried out after the holder confirms it.
- A payment-method change authorizes future drafts and must be confirmed the arrangement's payment-method change lead time (calendar days) before the next draft date to apply to that draft.
- An AutoPay arrangement cannot move to check, and a group arrangement always pays by employer remittance.
- An account closure or payment-method change is carried out only once the account holder's billing request for that account is confirmed. This is read from the status of that account's billing request in the company's system; the holder's statement alone does not satisfy it.

**Closure.** An account may be closed only when no enrollment it funds is applied or active and its balance is 0.00 after credits, refunds and write-offs (closure requires zero balance).

**Cases (hypothetical).**
| Billing request for the account | Funded enrollment applied or active | Balance after credits, refunds and write-offs | Closure carried out? |
|---|---|---|---|
| confirmed | none | 0.00 | yes |
| registered, not confirmed | none | 0.00 | no |
| confirmed | one active vision plan | 0.00 | no |
| confirmed | none | 14.20 owed | no |

A payment-method change confirmed 3 days before the next draft date on an arrangement with a 5-day lead time does not apply to that draft; confirmed 5 days before, it does.
